lcc_original: 上帝看光很好；上帝就把光暗分開了。
notes: Second God (H430): UNV uses implicit {<WH0430>} (God is elided), but LCC explicitly restates 上帝 — braces dropped per rule 3 and SN attached directly.
是好的 (UNV) → 很好 (LCC): both express H2896 טוֹב; SN attached to 很好.
UNV comma (，) → LCC semicolon (；): punctuation preserved exactly as LCC has it.
Direct object marker {<WH0853>} and conjunction {<WH03588>} remain implicit (braces kept) as LCC has no explicit words for either.
